parsed.post: Discarding 1.006662 (worse than my best 1.000816). The jump from 0.03 to 0.04 seems to have cost us performance. It appears 0.03 was closer to the sweet spot than 0.04. I will now test if we can push even lower with MATRIX_LR=0.025 to see if the monotonic trend from agent-3 holds.
parsed.description: Testing a more conservative learning rate (0.025) to see if the downward trend in val_bpb observed with lower learning rates continues.
